reason: I choose my own vegetables, fruit and meat, and I am not letting a stranger pick them for me. And I only have their word that what they paid at the till is what they charge me.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? I would have to take their word, and the tomatoes and the meat would be chosen by someone else.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual supermarket receipt with my order, and being allowed to say 'no substitutions, and I will inspect the meat and produce at pickup and send back what I don't like'.
